source: The descriptions of the skills that compete with this plugin's for the same requests: the released @joe-broadhead/opencode-metaview and @joe-broadhead/opencode-granola packages, and the gws, slack and linear plugins.

skills.metaview: Load before the first Metaview tool call (metaview_*, tools.metaview.*). For the user's recruiting interviews and candidates in Metaview - "what did <candidate> say about X", "summarise yesterday's screen with <name>", "which interviews did <interviewer> run last week", a candidate's interviews, including requests to guess a candidate's age, family or other personal traits, interview counts and themes by role, profiles and scorecards, reports, sourcing, screening, sequences and job posts, and Metaview sign-in. Not for non-hiring meetings (Granola), calendar scheduling or Slack.
skills.metaview-candidate-brief: Prep me for my interview with a candidate, brief me before a round, build a debrief or evidence pack, compare candidates or finalists for a role, check a scorecard against the transcript, or draft my interview feedback or scorecard, from Metaview. Builds a sourced brief and leaves every hiring decision to the user. Load with metaview before the first Metaview tool call. Not for non-hiring meetings or calls (granola-meeting-brief).
skills.metaview-write: Load before any Metaview change - regenerating notes or adding note sources, saving or sharing a snippet or clip, creating a report, AI field or note template, sourcing searches and candidate feedback, posting candidates to an ATS, application review rejects or progress and ICP changes, screening plans or invitations, sequences and outreach, contact enrichment, job posts - or before reporting a Metaview bug or problem to Metaview.
skills.granola: Load before the first Granola tool call (granola_*, tools.granola.*). For questions about the user's Granola meetings: what was said, decided or assigned, notes, transcripts, follow-ups, questions across meetings, saving meetings as Markdown, or Granola sign-in and sign-out.
skills.granola-meeting-brief: Prep me for my next or tomorrow's meeting, brief me before my call with a person or company, catch me up on a project, or recap a period's meetings, from the user's Granola notes. Builds a sourced brief of decisions, open questions and who owes what. Load before the first Granola tool call.
skills.opencode-gws: Use when working with Google Workspace accounts, reads, plans, commits, approvals, errors, or scripts that call these tools without a model.
skills.opencode-gws-recipes: Use when building a Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs, or Sheets request for gws_read or gws_plan.
skills.slack-search: Use when the user wants to find or read Slack messages, threads, channels, people or files, or asks what was said or decided in Slack. Searches public channels first, reads threads for context, and cites permalinks.
skills.linear: Use for questions about Linear issues, projects, cycles, initiatives, milestones, documents, comments, teams or users. Find, read and cite them with Linear's own tools.
